title: 第7章 道侣让我利益最大化第8章 气死叶龙渊
content_zh:
闻听此言，窝在韩风怀里的小狐狸，更加狐疑了。
“什么叫我和你是最好的朋友？我们昨晚才认识啊，到现在还没过十二个时辰呢，怎么就是最好的朋友呢？
你对我说这些花言巧语是什么意思？是不是想哄住我然后把我卖掉？”
“你这小家伙，岁数不大吧，猴精猴精的，我就是随口一说，你别乱想，你在我身上又没感受到恶意。”
“哼，本狐狸是最聪明的，不聪明能在你们人类的围追堵截下活这么久吗？”
“人族高手如云，你没半点修为实力，是怎么活下来的？”
“不告诉你。”
小狐狸很谨慎，两只大眼睛滴溜溜的转着，警惕的看着周围。
不多时，韩风便抱着小狐狸来到了落霞峰上面。
他这次来，是要办好几件事情呢。
首先，他要去的，是造册房，里面是登记、管理落霞峰所有弟子资料的地方。
杂役弟子晋升外门弟子，需要来这里考核登记。
来到了造册房，韩风看到里面有几个外门弟子打扮的年轻人，正在柜台里写着东西，便走过去问道，
“师兄，师弟有礼了，请问该去哪里登记考核成为外门弟子呢？”
那个低头忙活的弟子头也不抬，指了指门口里边放着的一个牌子。
韩风扭头看去，只见那牌子上写着，
【每月初一，所有突破练气期五层的弟子前来进行统一考核登记，晋升外门弟子。】
韩风满头黑线，叹了口气，这五年实在是太躺平了，连这事都没有了解清楚，王冕也没有给他说。
既然晋升不了，那就走吧。
此时，那个说话的弟子忽然抬起头来，看向韩风，说道，

“唉，你等会儿，我看你怎么有点眼熟啊？”
韩风扭过头来，问道，
“你认识我？”
“哦哦，我想起来了，你不就是昨天那个走了狗屎运，跟姜师姐结为道侣的杂役弟子嘛，叫什么名字来着我忘了。
对了，你不是修炼了几年还是废人嘛，怎么又要过来考核？你一夜突破到五层了？”
闻言，韩风笑道，
“哪能啊，我又不是神仙，是我一个同门杂役，快要突破到五层了，正在闭关修炼呢，托我过来帮忙问问，看哪一天能够考核。”
既然不能考核成为外门弟子，那自己已经有修为的事情，还是不要外传出去了，低调点好。
“每月初一，他要突破了就让他来吧。”
“多谢。”
韩风正要走的时候，忽然扭头问向那个弟子，说道，
“这位师兄，你知道姜师姐她住在哪里吗？”
“你是说姜酥柔师姐，你找她做什么？”
说到这里，那弟子哑然失笑，拍着脑门说道，
content_en:
After hearing this, the little fox nestled in Han Feng's arms became even more suspicious.
"What do you mean that you and I are best friends? We just met last night, and it hasn't been twelve hours yet, so how can we be best friends?
What do you mean by these sweet words to me? Are you trying to trick me and sell me? "
"You little guy, you're not that old, you're like a monkey. I just said it casually, don't think about it. You don't feel any ill will from me."
"Hmph, this fox is the smartest. How could he survive so long under the siege of you humans without being smart?"
"There are many human masters. How did you survive without any cultivation strength?"
"I won't tell you."
The little fox was very cautious, with his two big eyes rolling around and looking around vigilantly.
Not long after, Han Feng came to Luoxia Peak with the little fox in his arms.
He came here to do several things.
First of all, what he wanted to go to was to build a registration room, which was a place to register and manage the information of all the disciples of Luoxia Peak.
When a handyman disciple is promoted to an outer sect disciple, he needs to come here for assessment and registration.
When they arrived at the registration room, Han Feng saw a few young men dressed as outer disciples writing something at the counter, so he walked over and asked,
"Senior brother, you are polite, where can I go to register and take the exam to become an outer disciple?"
The disciple who was working with his head down did not raise his head and pointed at a sign placed inside the door.
Han Feng turned around and saw the sign that said,
[On the first day of every month, all disciples who have broken through the fifth level of the Qi training period come to register for a unified assessment and be promoted to outer disciples. 】
Han Feng's head was full of black lines and he sighed. He had been too flat in the past five years. He didn't even understand this matter clearly, and Wang Mian didn't tell him.
If you can't get promoted, then leave.
At this time, the disciple who was speaking suddenly raised his head, looked at Han Feng, and said,
"Hey, wait a minute, why do you look familiar to me?"
Han Feng turned around and asked,
"You know me?"
"Oh, I remembered. Aren't you the handyman disciple who got lucky and became a Taoist couple with Senior Sister Jiang yesterday? I forgot your name.
By the way, haven't you been practicing for several years and you're still a loser? Why do you have to come here for the assessment again? Did you break through to the fifth level overnight? "
Hearing this, Han Feng smiled and said,
"How can that be possible? I'm not a god. I'm just a servant from the same sect. He's about to break through to the fifth level. He's practicing in seclusion. He asked me to come over and help him find out when he can take the exam."
Since you can't pass the test to become an outer disciple, it's better not to spread the word about your cultivation and keep a low profile.
"On the first day of every month, if he wants to break through, let him do it."
"Thank you."
When Han Feng was about to leave, he suddenly turned to the disciple and said,
"Senior brother, do you know where Senior Sister Jiang lives?"
"You mean Senior Sister Jiang Surou, what are you doing with her?"
